description: How to drive the object_cutout tool (Meta SAM 2 video on Replicate) to isolate and track a subject into a transparent alpha cutout. Use when cutting out a person or object from a clip to overlay, keyframe, or restyle separately — the OpenNolan equivalent of Instagram Edits' "Cutouts". Covers click-prompt design, multi-object tracking, fixing tracking drift, mask types, and cost/caching.
